snippet.title: Dress Your Meat — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game set in a small dumpling restaurant. Your job is simple: take orders, prepare dumplings, cook them properly, and serve your customers

Follow the recipes, work fast, and try not to disappoint your chef

The Steam page is coming soon

Let us know what you think in the comments, and subscribe so you don't miss future updates

#DressYourMeat #IndieGame #HorrorGame #CookingGame
